purpose: 把网页、请求、响应、脚本和过程状态拆成可组合、可审计的抽象 token；不把整个页面压成少数标签。
design_principles: 每个可观察字段至少生成一个带轴前缀的 token；字段缺失生成显式 not_observed，而不是 false、零或省略。
token 轴是 append-only、带版本和来源；不得为了单次准确率删除低频轴。
原始 URL、payload、响应正文、凭据、oracle 答案和漏洞族标签不进入模型上下文；只保留结构、类型、长度桶、位置桶、编码链和脱敏哈希。
长页面按有序 section/element chunk 产生 token 序列；压缩必须保留计数、顺序、字段覆盖和 chunk hash，不能只留一个 surface 类别。
unknown 与 not_observed、empty、negative、blocked 是不同 token；观测不可得时模型应能生成 ASK。

document_structure.redaction: literal text/ids/classes become bounded shape, semantic role, length and salted digest; no raw text

navigation.redaction: origin/route literal is not retained; preserve segment count, character class, length bucket, key role and salted digest

request_transport.redaction: names/values use role, type, shape, order and bounded digest; secret/auth/cookie values are never stored

response_transport.redaction: body text is excluded; preserve only bounded shape/count/type and a non-reversible projection hash

javascript_surface.redaction: JavaScript literals and identifiers become syntax/AST/source/sink categories, counts and shape hashes; executable source is not model input

failure_feedback.redaction: error message literals become class/phase/shape; preserve transition identity and one-variable repair delta

belief_and_replay.redaction: oracle answer/effect type is evaluator-only; model sees availability, evidence presence, deltas and replay state

reserved_tokens.overflow_policy: bounded_overflow_plus_count_and_digest; overflow is a loss report, never silent truncation

context_firewall.allowed_form: axis=value where value is an ontology enum, bucket, role, shape or non-reversible digest

quality_gates.axis_coverage: every record carries every required axis or explicit axis=not_observed
quality_gates.entropy: per-axis source and fixed-holdout predictive entropy relative drop <= 0.25
quality_gates.sequence_diversity: unique complete sequences, not seed-only copies, are reported
quality_gates.field_ablation: removing one axis changes only that axis and produces a measurable downstream delta or is marked unused
quality_gates.split: source, implementation, family and near-duplicate groups are isolated
quality_gates.tokenizer: ontology hash, tokenizer hash and context/target offsets are recorded
